kommentar: Strudel control -> clip envelope target of a MIDI clip (strudel-clip). One row per Strudel control, named by the MAIN name Strudel stores (lpf and ctf arrive as cutoff, lpq as resonance). ziel: an envelope target of envelope.ts (HK_ZIELE). umrechnung turns the Strudel value into the unit of the target: rb_norm {parameter} = RB-338 display value to 0..1 (rb_mapping.ts), linear {von, nach} = linear map with clamping, gain_db {min_db} = 20 log10 of a gain factor. basis: 'spur' means the envelope is relative to the track, so the track's current value of basis_ziel is subtracted (the sound then equals the Strudel value while the track keeps that value); absent = the converted value is already relative (a gain curve in dB). nur_stetig: the row applies only to a control driven by a continuous signal; a discrete value of that control is read per note (gain becomes the velocity). Add a row to map a new control; a control without a row is reported as ohne_ziel.
